record.summary: Passive.CASTFORM has no PassiveEffects entry. Each of the four Castform classes defines beforeSimulationStart, which (unless the fight is a ghost battle) calls updateCastform(this, weather, player). updateCastform maps the simulation's weather to a form - SNOW -> CASTFORM_HAIL, RAIN -> CASTFORM_RAIN, DROUGHT or ZENITH -> CASTFORM_SUN, any other weather -> CASTFORM - and, if the unit is not already that form, calls player.transformPokemon(pokemon, form). The form (and so the unit's extra type and what the FORECAST skill adds on top of its shield) is therefore set from the weather at the start of each non-ghost fight. This record covers only the form change; the FORECAST skill is a separate record.
triggers: Simulation construction: beforeSimulationStart called for each unit on each player's board (including bench) with the simulation's weather and isGhostBattle flag
